courses.title: Moderating Focus Groups
courses.description: Moderating Focus Groups focuses on focus group moderation for people working toward a UX Researcher role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces interview technique, enough to apply alongside focus group moderation in real UX Researcher work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to focus group moderation and show how interview technique supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying focus group moderation to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing focus group moderation through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to interview technique
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Research Synthesis for Practitioners
courses.description: Research Synthesis for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of research synthesis, for people already working toward a UX Researcher role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in research synthesis and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying research synthesis to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing research synthesis through guided exercises
Building a short research synthesis exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Data Visualization Basics
courses.description: Data Visualization Basics walks you through the basics of data visualization, built for people new to UX Researcher work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of data visualization, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.

alternates.title: Focus Group Moderation Essentials
alternates.description: Focus Group Moderation Essentials is a short introduction to focus group moderation for people moving toward a UX Researcher role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show focus group moderation in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if focus group moderation is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying focus group moderation to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing focus group moderation through guided exercises
Building a short focus group moderation exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Focus Group Moderation Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Focus Group Moderation Techniques is a focused course on focus group moderation for people already working toward a UX Researcher role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying focus group moderation on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying focus group moderation to a real UX Researcher scenario
Practicing focus group moderation through guided exercises
Building a short focus group moderation exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
